segments.t: In a luxurious hotel room, Jose Garcia makes hasty excuses to his companion about an issue with his credit card before quietly slipping away down the corridor. Let's listen to the scene in French first.
Viens ici, reste encore un peu.
Je dois descendre à la réception.
Pourquoi es-tu si pressé maintenant?
J'ai un problème avec ma carte.
Tu peux régler cela plus tard.
Non, la réceptionniste m'attend en bas.
Tu reviens dans la chambre après?
Mets tout sur la note d'hôtel.
Tu as oublié ta veste noire.
Je la prends avec moi maintenant.
Je règle cette affaire très vite.
Attends, tu pars sans moi, José?
Ne t'inquiète pas, je descends juste.
Hein? José, où vas-tu donc?
Let's look at how Jose Garcia executes his discreet exit step by step.
Viens ici, reste encore un peu.
'Come here, stay a little longer.' Helene invites Jose to relax in bed.
Je dois descendre à la réception.
'I must go down to reception.' Jose makes an excuse to leave the room.
Pourquoi es-tu si pressé maintenant?
'Why are you in such a hurry now?' Helene wonders about his sudden haste.
J'ai un problème avec ma carte.
'I have a problem with my card.' Jose claims his payment card malfunctioned.
Tu peux régler cela plus tard.
'You can settle that later.' Helene urges him not to worry about the bill.
Non, la réceptionniste m'attend en bas.
'No, the receptionist is waiting downstairs.' Jose insists on sorting it out immediately.
Tu reviens dans la chambre après?
'Are you coming back to the room afterwards?' Helene asks for reassurance.
Mets tout sur la note d'hôtel.
'Put everything on the hotel bill.' Jose tells her to charge any extras.
Tu as oublié ta veste noire.
'You forgot your black jacket.' Helene notices his jacket on the chair.
Je la prends avec moi maintenant.
'I am taking it with me now.' Jose grabs his jacket in readiness.
Je règle cette affaire très vite.
'I will settle this matter very quickly.' Jose promises a prompt return.
Attends, tu pars sans moi, José?
'Wait, are you leaving without me, Jose?' Helene grows suspicious of his departure.
Ne t'inquiète pas, je descends juste.
'Do not worry, I am just going down.' Jose attempts to allay her concerns.
Hein? José, où vas-tu donc?
'Huh? Jose, where are you going?' Helene calls out as the door clicks shut. Now listen to the whole scene again at normal speed, and see how much more you catch.

Eager to escape an awkward morning reunion, Jose Garcia invents an errand at reception and slips out of the hotel room, leaving his bewildered companion behind. When you watch the episode, listen out for the expressions meaning 'come' and 'stay'. You'll catch them now. See you next time!
À bientôt!
